title: Re-tapping the active tab does not scroll to top
ios_ref: apps/ios/src/components/raised-tab-bar.tsx:211-214 (tabPress is emitted, but no screen uses useScrollToTop)
current_ios: Tapping the focused tab does nothing. The custom bar already emits 'tabPress', so React Navigation's useScrollToTop would work if screens attached a ref.
target: Re-tapping the home, pets, walks, leaderboard or settings tab scrolls that tab's main ScrollView or FlatList to the top.
fix_plan: In each tab screen ((tabs)/index.tsx, pets.tsx, walks.tsx, leaderboard.tsx, settings.tsx), create a ref on the root ScrollView or FlatList and call useScrollToTop(ref) from @react-navigation/native, which Expo Router already depends on.

title: Icon-only buttons without accessibilityLabel and sub-44pt tap targets; text buttons missing accessibilityRole
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/family/family-section.tsx (removeMember aria via Family.removeMember); web buttons are native <button>
ios_ref: apps/ios/app/family.tsx:249-251 (removeBtn padding 4, style 431); apps/ios/app/friends/index.tsx:171-173 (rowAction padding 4, style 305), 214-216 (🔍 search button); apps/ios/src/components/pets/receipt-scanner.tsx:112-114; apps/ios/src/components/home/home-top-bar.tsx:39; apps/ios/src/components/leaderboard/segmented.tsx:27; plus Pressables without accessibilityRole: settings.tsx:66,114,118; family.tsx:193,212-226,258; feed.tsx:46,55; friends/index.tsx:141,145,190,193,229,252,261,268; photos.tsx:161,181,215,225; onboarding.tsx:81-129; comment-section.tsx:183,208; photo-lightbox.tsx:120,131; post-card.tsx:103; post-composer.tsx:147-255; form-sheet.tsx:55,61; walk-tracking-view.tsx:227,236
current_ios: VoiceOver reads the remove-member X, remove-friend X and receipt-scanner close X as unlabeled 'button'/nothing; those X buttons are ~24pt + hitSlop 6 (≈36pt). Search button announces the emoji. Home bell is a non-interactive View announced as a button with hard-coded '通知'. Many text Pressables lack a role so VoiceOver doesn't announce 'button'; Segmented uses role 'button' instead of tab semantics.
target: Every interactive element has role + localized label; ≥44pt targets.
fix_plan: family.tsx:249 → accessibilityRole='button' accessibilityLabel={t('Family.removeMember')} and style removeBtn {minWidth:44,minHeight:44,alignItems:'center',justifyContent:'center'}; friends/index.tsx:171 → accessibilityLabel={t('Friends.removeConfirm')} + same 44pt style (rowAction); friends 214 → accessibilityRole='button' accessibilityLabel={t('Friends.tabs.search')}; receipt-scanner.tsx:112 → accessibilityRole='button' accessibilityLabel={t('Common.close')}; home-top-bar.tsx:39 → keep visual but set accessibilityLabel from new Home.notifications and drop role='button' until it is pressable (or make it a Pressable no-op like web). Add accessibilityRole='button' (legal links: 'link') to the listed Pressables. segmented.tsx: track accessibilityRole='tablist', items accessibilityRole='tab'. photos checkbox (26pt) → hitSlop 10; emoji moreBtn 36pt → hitSlop 4.

title: Modal slide transitions and lightbox dismiss/snap-back animations not gated by useReducedMotion
web_ref: docs/design-system.md:66 (all animations/transitions off under reduce — hard rule)
ios_ref: apps/ios/src/components/ui/Sheet.tsx:70; src/components/pets/form-sheet.tsx:49; src/components/walks/manual-walk-dialog.tsx:128; pet-pill.tsx:49; photo-prompt-sheet.tsx:34; walk-tracking-view.tsx:216; src/components/feed/post-composer.tsx:140; app/family.tsx:317,370; src/components/settings/family-section.tsx:310,363; delete-account-section.tsx:71; receipt-scanner.tsx:84,107; src/components/feed/photo-lightbox.tsx:97-102
current_ios: All sheets use animationType='slide' (RN Modal animation is not replaced by iOS Reduce Motion); photo-lightbox gates only the horizontal snap (93-94) but swipe-to-dismiss withTiming(160) and snap-back withSpring run regardless.
target: Under Reduce Motion, modals appear without slide and lightbox snaps instantly.
fix_plan: In each listed component `const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();` and pass `animationType={reduceMotion ? 'none' : 'slide'}` (or 'fade' → 'none' for fade modals). Centralize: Sheet.tsx and form-sheet.tsx first, then the ad-hoc Modals. photo-lightbox.tsx:97-102: when reduceMotion use withTiming(x,{duration:0}) for backdrop/translateY. Leave walks-dial sweep (intentional web parity per walks-dial.tsx:8 / web walks-dial.tsx:21-22).
